evidence_description: Supplier SUP-001 delivery slipped from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-16 (14-day delay).
Plant on-hand eligible API stock is 80 kg, insufficient to cover 127.5 kg requirement.
Production of 20,000 packs of Augmentin T10 cannot commence on 2026-11-09.
Delayed batch output from Plant Alpha leaves DC Nagpur without planned 20,000 pack replenishment.
DC unreserved stock of 16,000 packs is depleted by baseline customer demand across Weeks 1-3.
